seo.description: Book an Anakata Galápagos yacht expedition — sixteen guests at a time.

hero.sub: Seven nights, Sunday to Sunday, from San Cristóbal. Two expedition yachts, nine cabins each — never more.

search.hintStart: Pick a start month, then an end month.
search.hintEnd: Now pick an end month — or the same month again for a single-month window.
search.hintSet: Window set. Pick a start month to choose again.
search.footnote: Maximum {maxCabin} guests per cabin · {maxYacht} guests per yacht.
search.footnoteAdult: Every cabin with children includes an adult.

itineraries.title: Choose your itinerary
itineraries.sub: Each itinerary in brief — route, rhythm and rate. Open its departures to see live availability for your party inside your dates.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.body: The waitlist form arrives in the next task. We will take your details here.

map.foot: Hover a day to preview — click to pin its landing

cabins.title: Cabin selection
cabins.sub: Choose how many cabins, who sleeps where, and exactly which cabin on the deck plan. The price follows every choice.

details.title: Reservation details
details.sub: Just the essentials — your booking is obligation-free today. Our team confirms your cabins and answers any question before you pay anything.
details.advisor: I'm a travel advisor booking on behalf of a client
details.marketing: I'd like to receive news and expedition ideas from Anakata (optional)
details.pngDob: The PNG category estimate uses nationality and the 12-year cutoff. The final category depends on each guest's date of birth.
details.pngAirport: I will pay at SCY airport
details.tctLater: Arrange the TCT with the team later
details.depositWording: The deposit is on cruise charges only; extras and collected fees are due up to {hours} hours before departure.
details.opt1Body: We hold your cabins obligation-free and send the booking to our reservations team. They confirm availability and email your deposit link — nothing is charged today.
details.opt2Title: Book now, pay the deposit online
details.opt2Body: Confirm your cabins by paying the deposit online. The online advantage and on-board perk are applied when the server requotes.
details.formError: Please complete the highlighted fields above to continue
details.cancelled: Online payment was cancelled. Your request is still with the team — choose a path again or wait to hear from us.
details.priceChanged: The price changed. Review the new total and submit again.
details.promoFestiveRemoved: Your promo code does not apply to festive departures and was removed
details.payOnlineNote: Your deposit is paid online now. The online advantage is included above when the server quote returns.

confirm.requestLead: Thank you — your cabins are being held, obligation-free. A written confirmation is on its way to {email}.
confirm.paidLead: Thank you — your deposit has been received and your cabins are confirmed. A written confirmation is on its way to {email}.
confirm.paid1: Confirmed now — your cabins are secured and your deposit receipt is in your inbox.
confirm.paid2: The remaining balance is due before departure. No booking fees.
confirm.paid3: Our concierge gathers guest details and preferences, and curates flights, stays and on-board touches.
